coordinate_system: output pixels; rectangles [x,y,w,h]; bbox [left,top,right_exclusive,bottom_exclusive] sheet-global; pivots, eyes and head anchors cell-local

head_source.method: Exact approved U3 pixel mask; integer translation. Death tilts use three integer shears, preserving every head color cell without interpolation.

normalization.body: Generated body sampled onto logical grid, quantized to approved palette; alpha threshold 240.
normalization.q: Frames 4 and 5 forward arm-and-pistol group lowered four logical rows to waist level. Frame 4 flash recolored cyan-white.
normalization.idle: Six translated copies of approved native.
normalization.run: Head x fixed relative to pivot; head y varies by at most one logical row around its midpoint.
normalization.dash: Backward frames 5–8 reuse forward final frames exactly.
normalization.ult: Torso and legs held fixed relative to pivot.
normalization.raw: Raw model outputs are retained for provenance and are not import-ready.
